title: Juicy Australian Shrimp Wrap
description: A fresh and indulgent Australian dish featuring lime and ferment-kimchi, wrapped in a gluten-free corn husk wrap.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together lime juice, mayonnaise, salt, and pepper.
Add the Australian shrimp to the bowl and toss to coat with the lime juice mixture.
Grill the shrimp for 2-3 minutes per side, or until pink and cooked through.
Warm the corn husk wraps by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the wraps by spreading a tablespoon of ferment-kimchi on each wrap, then topping with a grilled shrimp, a sprinkle of chopped cilantro, and a squeeze of lime juice.
Garnish with additional chopped cilantro and lime wedges if desired.
Store any leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 24 hours.
